speaker: narrator
text: What if the *loudest sound* in history happened today?

speaker: narrator
text: Saturday, seven a.m. Every window in town *rattles*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay falls out of *bed*.

speaker: narrator
text: Outside, the whole street is staring at the *sky*.

speaker: narrator
text: No smoke. No fire. Just a *boom*.

speaker: boss
text: Fireworks! Who did this? Was it *you*, Jay?

speaker: hero
text: I was *asleep*!

speaker: bit
text: It wasn't fireworks. It was a *volcano*.

speaker: hero
text: We don't *have* a volcano.

speaker: bit
text: An island. Three thousand miles *away*.

speaker: bit
text: The sound took almost four hours to *get here*.

speaker: hero
text: Nothing is *that* loud.

speaker: bit
text: One thing was. *Krakatoa*. Eighteen eighty three.

speaker: bit
text: The loudest sound ever *recorded*.

speaker: bit
text: People heard it three thousand miles away.

speaker: bit
text: They thought it was a ship firing *cannons*.

speaker: bit
text: Sailors forty miles away lost their *eardrums*.

speaker: narrator
text: Grandpa Ezra steps out, holding a brass *barometer*.

speaker: scientist
text: The needle *jumped*. Air doesn't do that.

speaker: bit
text: That's the air wave. It's going around the *planet*.

speaker: bit
text: And it's coming back. From the *other side*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two drops in two days.
